//! Crate docs
use std::collections::HashMap;

/// A point in space.
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub struct Point<T> {
    x: T,
    y: T,
}

impl<T: std::ops::Add<Output = T> + Copy> Point<T> {
    pub fn sum(&self) -> T {
        self.x + self.y
    }
}
